biotools.summary: MMIST (Molecular and Morphodynamics-Integrated Single-cell Trajectories) is a computational framework that links single-cell measures of cell phenotype and behavior to molecular readouts, enabling prediction of dynamic changes in gene expression programs. The framework leverages time-lapse image data and links it to gene transcription levels to map live-cell dynamics to snapshot gene transcript levels.
